name: PyPDF
description: Splits a PDF into one-page PDFs: all pages or a page range. The text and images of the pages come from Poppler.

split.name: Split PDF to pages
split.description: Splits a PDF into one-page PDF files. Give a page range to split only some pages; the original PDF is deleted afterwards unless you keep it.

pages.name: Pages
pages.help: Pages to split, for example 1-5,8,10- . Empty means all pages.

delete_original.name: Delete the original PDF after splitting
delete_original.help: The file is removed from disk and the node stays as a record. Without it, the pages are the only way to work with the content.
delete_original.warning: Pages outside the range are lost for good.
